item.title: Carbon Pricing’s Impact on Global Industry Is Quietly Growing
item.description: Carbon pricing schemes cover ~30% of global emissions—led by the EU and China—and are impacting corporate costs and investment flows, with carbon border mechanisms amplifying their impact and accelerating adoption worldwide.

item.title: Greg Jensen and Nir Bar Dea on the Importance of AI Regulation
item.description: Co-CIO Greg Jensen and CEO Nir Bar Dea discuss the importance of regulating AI development, the risks around a major safety incident, and how to prepare for potential AI-driven labor displacement.
